verified.contract: asChild preserves a nested Fragment path during SSR hydration without mismatch warnings
deferred Select and Toast Teleports hydrate into an existing target without mismatch warnings
host-generated IDs preserve server-to-client identity and relationships
conditional popup presence hydrates both initially open and closed variants
hidden form controls preserve SSR hydration and native submission state
Tabular profiles preserve SSR structure and defer resolver execution until client mount
Form hydration registers participants once and preserves controlled value ownership
Composite fields preserve declarative group labels and native submission metadata through SSR hydration and field-default overrides
Select fields preserve native label targets, inherited submission metadata and stable identities from SSR through hydration and trigger replacement
